# routeros_interface_vpls (Resource)


## Example Usage
```terraform
resource "routeros_interface_vpls" "vpls" {
  name        = "example"
  arp         = "disabled"
  arp_timeout = "10s"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the VPLS interface.

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `arp` (String) Address Resolution Protocol mode:
  * disabled - the interface will not use ARP
  * enabled - the interface will use ARP
  * local-proxy-arp - the router performs proxy ARP on the interface and sends replies to the same interface
  * proxy-arp - the router performs proxy ARP on the interface and sends replies to other interfaces
  * reply-only - the interface will only reply to requests originated from matching IP address/MAC address combinations which are entered as static entries in the ARP table. No dynamic entries will be automatically stored in the ARP table. Therefore for communications to be successful, a valid static entry must already exist.
- `arp_timeout` (String) ARP timeout is time how long ARP record is kept in ARP table after no packets are received from IP. Value auto equals to the value of arp-timeout in IP/Settings, default is 30s. Can use postfix `ms`, `s`, `m`, `h`, `d` for milliseconds, seconds, minutes, hours or days. If no postfix is set then seconds (s) is used.
- `bridge` (String) The bridge the interface is dynamically added to as a bridge port.
- `bridge_cost` (Number) Spanning tree cost of the dynamically created bridge port.
- `bridge_horizon` (String) Bridge horizon of the dynamically created bridge port. Accepts an integer or `none`, in which case the bridge horizon is not used.
- `bridge_pvid` (Number) Port VLAN ID (PVID) of the dynamically created bridge port.
- `cisco_static_id` (Number) Cisco-style VPLS tunnel identifier. Used together with `pw_type` to signal a Cisco compatible static pseudowire.
- `comment` (String)
- `disable_running_check` (Boolean) Whether to detect if the interface is running or not.
- `disabled` (Boolean)
- `mac_address` (String) MAC address of the VPLS interface.
- `mtu` (Number) Layer3 Maximum Transmission Unit of the VPLS interface.
- `peer` (String) The IP address of the remote peer of the pseudowire.
- `pw_control_word` (String) Enables or disables the usage of the pseudowire Control Word.
- `pw_l2mtu` (Number) The L2MTU value advertised to the remote peer.
- `pw_type` (String) Pseudowire type.
- `vpls_id` (String) A unique number that identifies the VPLS tunnel. Written either as `AS:number` or as `IP:number`, e.g. `65000:1` or `10.0.0.1:1`.

### Read-Only

- `bgp_signaled` (Boolean) Whether the pseudowire was signaled by BGP.
- `bgp_vpls` (String) The BGP VPLS instance the dynamically created pseudowire belongs to.
- `bgp_vpls_prfx` (String) The BGP VPLS prefix the dynamically created pseudowire was built from.
- `cisco_bgp_signaled` (Boolean) Whether the pseudowire was signaled by BGP using the Cisco style encoding.
- `dynamic` (Boolean) Configuration item created by software, not by management interface. It is not exported, and cannot be directly modified.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `running` (Boolean)

## Import
Import is supported using the following syntax:
```shell
#The ID can be found via API or the terminal
#The command for the terminal is -> :put [/interface/vpls get [print show-ids]]
terraform import routeros_interface_vpls.vpls "*1"
```
